Match their exact hand-painted art family: deep jade/teal, warm ivory silk-paper panels, thin warm-gold rims, rounded ruyi/cloud carving, soft sophisticated shading, clear readable Chinese. Text exactly as specified below, concise with strong size hierarchy. Natural full-screen art, no device mockup, no explanation board except when task explicitly asks state/component board. No photorealism, plastic 3D, excessive sparkle, watermarks, borrowed branding, or extra unreadable text. Preserve native details and do not render a wireframe. Example values are visual mock data.

Task: 16:9 single polished 获得奖励 popup over gently dimmed jade sea background. Three generous reward items 铜钱 ×2,000 / 灵玉碎片 ×5 / 冰封符 ×1 each crisp icon, subtle warm gold glow contained behind panel. Primary 领取 / secondary 查看背包. No excessive sparkles or casinos.
